title: 建築計画
subtitle: Architectural Planning
teachers:
KAWASAKI Yasushi
授業科目の学習・教育目標
educationalGoal:
Students will:
(1) learn functions and composition of various modern architectures based on human activities
(2) gain knowledge about external space planning and urban space related to architecture
advice:
This is a basic course of architectural planning. We will address the following:
Courses are conducted in the form of in-person lectures, but a video clip explaining the content of each course is uploaded to the e-syllabus. Students can take courses both in person and on demand.

1. Housing/Apartment Housing
2. Kindergartens/Schools
3. Training and lodging facilities
4. Libraries/Museums
5. Theaters/Halls
6. Offices
7. Planning basics
8. External spaces related to architecture
9. Urban space and architecture
books:
Textbooks：Textbook of Architectural Planning based on Human Activities (Gakugei)
Reference books：None
Reserved books：None
requiredKnowledge: This is an introductory class for architectural planning and does not require any special background knowledge or skills. We want students to form their own values toward architecture and cities based on the knowledge of this class.

activityGoals.body: Students understand architectural spaces in terms of functions, convenience, safety, and comfort.
Students understand basic space plans common to architecture.
Students understand city spaces related to architecture, and urban space design.
Students can reflect on architectural and urban space plans based on their acquired knowledge.

achievementLevels.ideal:
Students understand the correspondence between human activities and space in various architectures and understand functional, safe, and comfortable architectural plans.
They understand urban space and urban design, and the relationship between these and architecture.

In addition, they will discover and evaluate their own concepts and features of good architecture and attractive areas.
